english.title: Sign a false health certificate for the consignment of animal / genetic material to other member state

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) signed a health certificate for the consignment of

(A)_[an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..),]_
(B)_[genetic material, namely **(..SPECIFY GENETIC MATERIAL..),]_

to another member state, namely **(..SPECIFY THE STATE..), knowing it to be false, or not believing it to be true
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 6(6), 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
signed a health certificate for the consignment of an animal / genetic material to another member state /
knowing it to be false or not believing it to be true.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: For an offence committed on or after 13/12/19, see offence wording document H20647

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
